material.locator: ICRC, Handbook on International Rules Governing Military Operations (2013), Part I, §2.1.0.3 “Sources of international law”, p. 45.
material.description: Provides general doctrinal context on sources of international law. It does not independently establish the specific sovereign-equality and peaceful-settlement principles in Claim C; those are supported directly by UN Charter Article 2(1) and Article 2(3).
